row.team_price_text: Lite: $5.1/user/mo billed annually ($51/mo for a 10-user bucket)
row.evidence: Favro's pricing page lists SAML-based SSO and SCIM user provisioning only on the Enterprise plan (Talk to Sales), and its Okta SCIM guide says the organization must be on the Enterprise plan.
row.notes: Lite $5.1 and Standard $6.8 per user/mo billed annually, sold in user buckets (2, 5, 10, 25, 50+); Enterprise is tailored pricing. SCIM 2.0 (and legacy 1.1) at https://favro.com/api/scim/v2 with a per-domain bearer token that only exists once SAML SSO is configured on a verified domain. SCIM DELETE disables the user rather than deleting it; roles are set with the favroRole attribute. Entra uses a non-gallery app with the ?aadOptscim062020 flag; Google Workspace is a custom SAML app (SSO only). The REST API (basic auth with API tokens) gets 0 calls/hour on Lite, so user API needs Standard. No user-event webhooks or audit-log API documented.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: API calls/hour: 0 on Lite. OAuth via Google & GitHub only.

scim.notes: SCIM v1.1 is also served at https://favro.com/api/scim/v1; Favro recommends v2.0.

auth.token_source: Administration > Authentication methods > (verified SAML domain) > SCIM API token

operations.notes: DELETE /Users/:userId is documented as 'Disables a user'; no SCIM hard delete. Reactivation via active=true on PUT.

deprovision.data_retained: Disabled members are frozen: their data stays available and they stay on assigned cards; the account can be re-enabled.

filtering.notes: Documented filter example: userName eq email@domain.com.

custom.how: favroRole (or FavroRole in entitlements) sets the workspace role: Administrator (must be enabled per domain), Full Member, External Member, Guest; default Full Member.

roles.how: favroRole attribute / entitlements on the SCIM user; Administrator role needs 'Provision users with administrator role' enabled on the domain

limitations.text: Admin users cannot be provisioned by default; enable 'Provision users with administrator role' on the domain.
Entra tenant URL must end in ?aadOptscim062020 (non-gallery app).
Okta integration supports create, update attributes, deactivate and group push.

auth.notes: API tokens can be restricted to read-only endpoints.

capabilities.notes: Invites, role changes and removals go through PUT /organizations/:organizationId (shareToUsers / members with delete:true).

endpoints.purpose: Invite users, change roles or remove users from the organization

webhooks_user_events.notes: Outgoing webhooks documented only for card and comment events (c47).

rate_limits.text: Organization routes: Trial 100, Lite 0, Standard 1,000, Enterprise 10,000 calls/hour per user; user-level routes 50 calls/hour; token-bucket throttling, 429 when delay exceeds 10 s.

limitations.text: Lite plan gets 0 API calls per hour.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML and SCIM; Favro's guide lists create, update, deactivate, group push.

entra.notes: Favro's Entra guide uses 'Create your own application' (non-gallery) with the generic SCIM endpoint; no Learn tutorial found (404).

google.notes: Favro documents a custom SAML app in Google Workspace (SSO only, no provisioning).

onelogin.notes: From Favro's own OneLogin guides (Favro SAML 2.0 app with SCIM Base URL/Bearer token).
